Exchanges.Text: Good morning, Payments (Demo) team. Our sprint goal is “Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically,” and there are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check on your earlier commitments: is story 3 done, is story 4 done, and is task 19 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, the Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests today.

Task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.
For task 19, which may slip while you finish the idempotency keys, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, is story 5 done from when you said “I’ll chase them today,” and is bug 12 done from when you said “I’ll pair with Daniel on staging access today”?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot; Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Who can help unblock you on access to the platform team’s staging gateway so you can continue settlement file validation?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker—waiting on the security review—and your commitment to chase them today; blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, is story 1 done and is task 14 done from your earlier commitments?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday, I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: Keep working on the payment retry story today.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Who can help unblock this, the sandbox being down that caused task 14 to slip, so you can finish it tomorrow?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Need the sandbox from the platform team, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Recap: blockers raised were that task 19 may slip and will be flagged if it does, access is needed to the platform team’s staging gateway, the security review is still pending, the sandbox was down, and the sandbox is needed from the platform team.  
We parked an offline side discussion about the gateway timeouts and configuration between sandbox and staging.  
Task 15 is stale and wasn’t covered, and its owners will get a follow-up about it.  
Follow-ups are coming in Teams, and with that, thank you everyone.
